title: Write targets an agent code-execution runtime
description: Targets the execution-environment artifact described by Varonis; detects an attempted write, not exploitation success.

classification.rationale: Possible tool-runtime poisoning; ordinary maintenance and test copies also match.

falsepositives: Authorized runtime upgrades, backups, or local security fixtures.
investigation: Compare a trusted runtime image with the changed file and review Playbooks.UpdatePlaybook audit records if this is Dialogflow.
